mapper.insert: insert into seat (seat_number, name, capacity, area, qr_code, status, remark, create_time, update_time, create_user, update_user) values (#{seatNumber}, #{name}, #{capacity}, #{area}, #{qrCode}, #{status}, #{remark}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{createUser}, #{updateUser})
mapper.update: update seat set status = #{status}, update_time = #{updateTime} where id = #{id}
update seat set status = 1, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and status = 0
mapper.select: select status, count(*) as cnt from seat group by status
